listingUrls.title: Listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Wellfound listing pages to crawl, e.g. ['https://wellfound.com/jobs', 'https://wellfound.com/jobs?r=1']

fetchDetails.title: Fetch Company Pages
fetchDetails.description: Visit each company page to capture funding stage, website and description. Disable for a fast listing-only pass (team size and tags only).

headless.title: Headless Mode
headless.description: Run headless. Leave off (headful via xvfb) for bot-protected sites — headful passes Cloudflare far more often.

useProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
useProxy.description: Route through Apify residential proxy. Recommended: Wellfound applies aggressive bot detection.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy Groups
proxyGroups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use when useProxy is on
